original_question: Adadin samun Eliza a kowace awa na sa'o'i 40 na farko da take aiki kowane mako samunta shine $10. Haka kuma ana biyanta ninki 1.2 na na abinda ake biyanta duk awa idan ta yi aikin obatayim.  Idan Eliza ta yi aiki na awanni 45 a wannan makon, nawa ne abin da ta samu a wannan makon?
